# LERP (Luau Education for Rive Professionals) — Landing Page
> Canonical URL: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/lerp/
> Purpose: Marketing landing page for the LERP interactive scripting course.
> Language: English

## About LERP
LERP is the first interactive course built specifically for Rive's Luau scripting runtime.
77 lessons, 201 exercises, 189 quizzes across 8 parts. Free forever, MIT licensed.
No account required. No tracking. Progress stored in localStorage only.

## Course Content (full documentation)
